summary: Two listed churches. St. Lawrence O'Toole has the weekend, weekday and Monday/Friday confession times in the box on page 1 of every bulletin read; Sacred Heart has only a Sunday 10:30 Mass. The newest issue adds a noon All Souls Mass and no confessions on Nov 2. History's Saturday 8:30 Mass is a Rosary. Open: website-only First Friday 7 PM Mass, a once-printed Fourth Friday Healing Mass, and perpetual adoration with no stated hours.

sources.said: Divine Mercy Adoration Chapel, Perpetual Adoration, St Lawrence O'Toole Church, 31 Prospect St, Brewster, NY. Weekend and overnight adoration is available

slots.rationale: R30, R38: the parish website describes perpetual adoration in a chapel at the church (R6: the parish's own page), with a Blessed Sacrament exposed in a monstrance and adorers signed up for every day. No bulletin read prints Adoration hours (the Sep 27 and Oct 18 issues mention Adoration only in a one-off talk and in general text), and the site gives no clock times, so 24 hours a day is inferred from 'perpetual'. Leaning include because the parish calls it perpetual.
